items.authored_reason: The flow field, TDVP residual color map, and isolated periodic orbit are generated independently from the printed equations of motion; the code-ready paper-scale campaign refines the orbit and finite-ring leakage checks.
Independent constrained-space time evolution covers the local-observable relaxation and revival curves. The paper does not report the quench L values, so parameter ambiguity remains.

The named symmetry sector has executable per-size diagonalization shards and aggregation. The paper caption omits the indispensable plotted system-size sequence, so the declared candidate sweep remains parameter_ambiguity and no plot-coordinate inference is used to claim paper_exact.
The printed periodic L=30 six-site entropy through t*Omega=100 has an executable blocked-MPS/tDMRG campaign with time-step and bond refinements.
The printed periodic L=30 one-site entropy through t*Omega=120 shares the same checkpointed paper-scale campaign.
The spin-1 flow field, TDVP residual color map, and periodic orbit are generated independently from the printed equations; the paper-scale channel adds orbit and finite-ring convergence checks.
Independent constrained-space time evolution covers the spin-1 local-observable relaxation and revival curves. The paper does not report the quench L values.
The spin-2 flow field, TDVP residual color map, and periodic orbit are generated independently from the printed equations; the paper-scale channel adds orbit and finite-ring convergence checks.
Independent constrained-space time evolution covers the spin-2 local-observable relaxation and revival curves. The paper does not report the quench L values.
The h/Omega=-0.2 deformed vector field is regenerated directly from the supplemental equations of motion.
The h/Omega=0 deformed vector field is regenerated directly from the supplemental equations of motion.
The h/Omega=0.2 deformed vector field is regenerated directly from the supplemental equations of motion.
The h/Omega=0.4 deformed vector field is regenerated directly from the supplemental equations of motion.
The integrated TDVP-orbit error is generated from an independently evaluated finite-ring MPS residual with an explicit convergence check.

checks.statement: The h/Omega grid, Hamiltonian sign, TDVP flow sign, gamma definition, and printed minimum were traced independently to the publication source.
A direct product-basis Hamiltonian equals the case implementation in the publication-literal sign lane.

The deformed flow reduces to the undeformed spin-1/2 flow at h=0.
The last two finite rings agree within 1.4e-7.
The frozen S2 arrays are bound to the accepted isolated numerical run.
